channel.title: NotAlaska Games reviews
channel.description: Game reviews from NotAlaska Games, who play indie horror and weird games badly on purpose, usually with mods.

item.title: Forest Escape: Last Train review: clowns, flying ears and butts in top hats
item.description: Forest Escape: Last Train is a co-op surreal horror game for 1 to 4 players from Frag Lab, published with Two Cakes Studio and in Early Access since July 2026.

item.title: MECCHA CHAMELEON review: hide-and-seek where you paint yourself to match the map
item.description: MECCHA CHAMELEON starts me as a blocky white body that has to paint itself to blend in with the map.

item.title: How to Fish review: we caught a whole cow, and I summoned a flock of invisible seagulls
item.description: Dazed Games released How to Fish on Steam in August 2026, a physics-based fishing simulator for 1 to 4 players. I played it with two friends.

item.title: Don't Mess With Bober review: a revenge beaver, a super jump and a lot of yeeting
item.description: Don't Mess With Bober is a first-person walking sim with a touch of 80s horror movies, from Peace_Studio and DonCorsaire, out on Steam since July 2025.

item.title: Find the Box review: a cozy digging game I modded into a horror game
item.description: Find the Box is a cozy first-person digging game from Taco Games, out on Steam since November 4, 2026.

item.title: Mayhem À La Carte playtest review: four-player cooking shooter with toaster guns, then a Ratatouille mod
item.description: In Mayhem À La Carte you run a diner while masked gunmen walk in and shoot at you.

item.title: CRACK review: three-player egg cracking, then a modded speedrun
item.description: CRACK puts you in a lab with one job: crack a giant egg.

item.title: The Pale Mimic review: a bazooka moose hunt and a monster that copies voices
item.description: In Dark Snow Games' The Pale Mimic you're a fugitive hiding in the Alaskan wilderness with only your dog.

item.title: Gnome review: house-sitting horror with an axe-holding gnome
item.description: echomune's Gnome has you house-sitting for a friend.

item.title: Spring Me Up review: a punishing spring climb, played as a banana
item.description: More Pain's Spring Me Up gives you one tool, a big spring on your body, and one job: climb.

item.title: Slay the Spire 2 review: co-op deckbuilding with AI-redrawn enemies
item.description: Slay the Spire 2 is a roguelike deckbuilder: you climb the Spire collecting cards, relics and potions, and every climb plays out differently.

item.title: Palworld review: weird Pals and an F-14 fighter jet mod
item.description: Palworld has you live alongside creatures called Pals, or fight off a poaching syndicate.

item.title: Alien: Isolation review: survival horror, but the Alien is Thomas the Tank Engine
item.description: Alien: Isolation puts me on Sevastopol, a decommissioned trading station, as Amanda Ripley, fifteen years after the events of Alien, looking for what happened to my mother.

item.title: Lethal Company review: co-op horror, but everyone is a duck
item.description: In Lethal Company, the co-op horror game from Zeekerss, you and your crew land on abandoned moons, grab scrap and sell it to the Company to meet the quota.

item.title: Helldivers 2 review: throwing rats and missing the shuttle
item.description: Helldivers 2 is an online co-op third-person shooter from Arrowhead Game Studios.

item.title: Jump Space review: giant bananas and jetpack boarding
item.description: Jump Space makes you and up to three others the crew of one spaceship.
